name: dogfood-llm-multi-agent-swarm-app
description: Dogfood app v1.40-2 — a Multi-agent orchestration + Swarm coordination service that drives an LLM planning + delegation + graph transition + consensus + Byzantine-fault-tolerance surface backed by @kiwa/ai-llm v0.5 advanced III semantics (LangGraph + CrewAI + AutoGen supervisor pattern + role-based agent swarm), runnable in both KIWA_MODE=real (Vercel AI SDK + Anthropic Messages API when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY + KIWA_LLM_BUDGET_USD are set) and KIWA_MODE=mock (in-memory state machine + deterministic delegation + majority vote) so behavioural fidelity feeds @kiwa/quality-metrics 11-axis release gate.

scripts.test: pnpm -F @kiwa/ai-llm -F @kiwa/core -F @kiwa/quality-metrics build && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node
